lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five staggered horizontal rows situated between the longitudinal carinae, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured grid where the blobs act as high-intensity nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient consisting of high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a very low density of high-luminance blobs, with only a few small, faint clusters visible near the base and posterior margin; the majority of the fin surface presents as a dark, uniform macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and trailing beneath the primary pectoral fin.
